_comment: Authoritative start positions (#45). Server and clients place every arena's SpawnPoints markers from this file; changing any value is a gameplay change: bump WireCodec.BUILD. Game metres, arena centre at the origin, team 1 on +Z. Every start faces the arena centre; AuthorityWorld.clear_spawn_pose still pulls a hull off walls and onto its terrain.

team_lanes._comment: Which of the five team lanes (1..5, left to right seen from the team's side) each match size uses. Duels meet in the centre lane.

arenas._comment: team: the five team-1 lanes as [x, z]; team 2 is the same set mirrored through the centre. ffa_radius: the eight free-for-all starts sit on this ring, 45 degrees apart, the first on +Z. Woodland's lanes match its flattened terrain pads (woodland_ground.gd), Moon's its levelled pads (moon_surface.gd).

moon._comment: A shallow arc 20 m out with 9 m between neighbours: Foundry's row scaled to this 50 m octagon left 1.2 m between hulls and pinned the outer bots against the chamfers.

practice._comment: Offline practice starts at the edges, not in a central huddle: the player takes team-1 lane player_lane, the stationary calibration target waits target_gap metres (hull to hull) ahead of it, and the two mobile pilots start at the free-for-all starts in pilot_starts (1..8), on the arena's flanks.
